decisions.reason: As a close-to-core aviation data solution with a dedicated page, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and a large firm has enough slack to keep developing it.
Demand may be less certain as travel health rules normalise, but its dedicated page and fit with the firm's compliance services justify retaining it while results remain ambiguous.
This training module fits the firm's trainer base and cross-selling logic, so even modest standalone results would likely be acceptable relative to aspiration levels.
Although uptake may be slower because behaviour-analysis systems are complex and scrutinised, it still extends the firm's specialist detection offer enough to warrant continued market presence.

Its lower website prominence and the legal and reputational sensitivity of passenger profiling in Germany make it the clearest candidate to fall below aspiration and trigger reallocation of resources.
A document verification platform is close to the firm's established airport and border-security business, and its dedicated page suggests commitment and acceptable early traction.
